data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Jeromeos', which means 'exalted name of the Lord'. In Christianity, Jerome is the name of a renowned saint, scholar, and doctor of the Church known for his translation of the Bible into Latin. The name Jérôme carries the meaning “Exalted name of the Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jérôme usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted name of the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
